rules: Internal analytical identifiers may be used by the SQL planner when required for grouping, joins or deterministic processing.
PII schema fields are excluded from normal aggregate model context.
first_name and phone may be projected only for an explicit authorized local customer-record request.
PII-containing customer result rows must not be sent to the Insight Analyst or any subsequent model analysis step.
Aggregate or count-only customer requests must not retrieve first_name, phone or other PII.
Secret and denied fields are never projected, logged or sent to the model.
Customer identity for analytics is customer.id / order.customer_id, never phone, email or name.
